class.name: PerformanceBudgetFailure
class.brief_description: One failed rule of a [PerformanceBudget] check.
class.description: A [PerformanceBudgetFailure] is part of a [PerformanceBudgetResult]. It tells which rule failed, why, and the measured value.

method.name: get_actual_value
method.description: Returns the measured value of the statistic. [code]0.0[/code] with [constant REASON_COLUMN_MISSING] and [constant REASON_NO_SAMPLES].

method.name: get_limit
method.description: Returns the limit of the rule at the time of the check ([member PerformanceBudgetRule.limit]).

method.name: get_message
method.description: Returns a readable message, for example [code]"frame_time p95 = 18200 exceeds the limit 16667."[/code].

constants.constant: The statistic is greater than the limit.
The column of the rule was not recorded. Add it to the [PerformanceRecordingProfile].
